model.auxiliary: signed symmetric pair-marginal fresh game; not unit-client CAG
model.domain: 1<=m<=p, all ordered histories of distinct labels; repeats forbidden only in this auxiliary model
model.coefficients: alpha per label and beta per unordered pair, signs unrestricted
model.theta: min over all (m-1)-sets H max unused a v_a(H+a)
model.sample_low: minimum of (pay,a,terminal bitmask) over every root SPE terminal and all its labels; arbitrary player position

BI.exact_mathematical_recursion: threshold(H)=max_a min_{S in child outcomes}v_a(S); union child leaves with payoff>=threshold
BI.cache: occupied sets cache realizability sets; independent ordered-h subtrees reconstructed separately
BI.small_integer_sample_stage: coefficients -3..3, pay/threshold/theta all exact small Python integers, tolerance cannot merge different integers
BI.policy: complete dict keyed ordered tuples, onpath target preserved, offpath child minimizes own deviator payoff, recursive all fresh children

LP.variables: all d coefficients in [-1,1] plus free common z
LP.IC: every nonself legal fresh action at every complete ordered policy node against its own true continuation
LP.static_witness: for each H choose an old-point argmax a_H, keep fixed, constrain z<=new v_aH(H+aH)
LP.valid_lower_bound: z<=min_H new v_aH<=min_H max_a new v_a=theta(new)
LP.objective: min new v_low(target)-z, selected label need not be root action
LP.conditional_refutation: an exact feasible negative objective would disprove only auxiliary individual floor candidate
LP.restriction: one fixed full sigma and one old query per H; nonnegative LP optimum is not all-policy theorem
LP.numerics: SciPy HiGHS floats; assert res.success only; no Fraction recovery, exact IC/duals/optimum or independent BI postcheck

driver.first_LP: sample i=0 if LP enabled and sample gap does not fail
driver.output: write once after loop or failure then print same JSON, no append newline or mkdir/overwrite protection
driver.invalid_domain_not_checked: 1<=m<=p, samples>=1, supplied coefficient vector dimension; nonpositive samples can leave i unbound
